nphi.title: China CDC – RIVM memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: RIVM (National Institute for Public Health and the Environment)
nphi.summary: Agreement signed during an RIVM delegation visit to Beijing covering ten areas, among them infectious and chronic disease control, health promotion and cross-border outbreak response; the visit included a One Health seminar.

nphi.title: GHPP China – green hospitals and efficient medicine use
nphi.actor: Netherlands Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS)
nphi.with: Chinese health authorities (not named on the source page)
nphi.summary: Government-to-government partnership on efficient use of medicines, energy-efficient hospitals and switching from polluting anaesthetic gases to intravenous anaesthesia.

nphi.title: China CDC – IPK Cuba memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Instituto de Medicina Tropical Pedro Kourí (IPK)
nphi.summary: Agreement between China CDC and Cuba's tropical medicine institute, both IANPHI members, on tropical disease control, laboratory diagnostics, emergency response and training.

nphi.title: China CDC Ebola response expert deployments to Uganda and DRC (2026)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO; Uganda Incident Management Support Team; DRC health authorities
nphi.summary: At the invitation of Africa CDC and WHO, China CDC sent successive expert teams in 2026 to support Ebola surveillance, laboratory capacity and infection control in Uganda and the DRC.

nphi.title: China CDC – NUS Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health cooperation MoU
nphi.with: National University of Singapore – Saw Swee Hock School of Public Health
nphi.summary: MoU signed in Singapore in September 2026 on AMR surveillance, infectious disease modelling and forecasting, wastewater surveillance, and joint training of professionals and graduate students.

nphi.title: Singapore CDA – China NDCPA MoU
nphi.with: National Disease Control and Prevention Administration (NDCPA), China
nphi.summary: MoU between Singapore's Communicable Diseases Agency and China's National Disease Control and Prevention Administration, signed on 19 May 2026 at the World Health Assembly.

nphi.title: WHO Collaborating Centre for Innovation and Global Cooperation for TB Elimination (China CDC)
nphi.with: WHO; China CDC Centre for Tuberculosis Control and Prevention; National Disease Control and Prevention Administration
nphi.summary: WHO collaborating centre hosted by China CDC, inaugurated in Beijing in August 2026, intended to help other countries strengthen tuberculosis prevention and control, with a first set of 13 TB practical training bases.

nphi.with: China CDC; NPHIs of BRICS members and partner countries (nearly 30 representatives)

nphi.title: Vietnam–China cross-border training and exchange centre for infectious disease control (Chongzuo)
nphi.with: Health authorities of Lang Son and Cao Bang provinces, Vietnam
nphi.summary: Chongzuo CDC in Guangxi and the neighbouring Vietnamese provinces of Lang Son and Cao Bang opened a cross-border training and exchange centre for infectious disease control, alongside a Guangxi surveillance and prevention training base.

nphi.title: China CDC – NPHA Sierra Leone seminar on priority infectious diseases and lab capacity
nphi.with: National Public Health Agency of Sierra Leone (NPHA); Ministry of Health Sierra Leone; Africa CDC

nphi.summary: A Thai Department of Disease Control epidemiology delegation visited China CDC in February 2025 to discuss deeper FETP collaboration. In July 2026 the two FETPs held their first face-to-face modular joint academic exchange, meant as the…

nphi.title: Lancang-Mekong Subregional Joint Laboratory Network for Tropical Disease Control
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: Partner institutions in the Lancang-Mekong subregion
nphi.summary: Network launched in 2025 at the RNAS+ annual meeting, with an MoU signed by NIPD to link tropical-disease laboratories of the five Mekong countries on shared objectives, target diseases and a work plan.

nphi.title: China CDC support for setting up a national CDC in Mongolia
nphi.with: Mongolia Ministry of Health; National Center for Communicable Diseases; National Center for Public Health
nphi.summary: After Mongolia's 2024 public health law created a national CDC, a Mongolian delegation studied China CDC's structure and China CDC pledged comprehensive support for establishing the new centre.

nphi.title: China CDC – Africa CDC cooperation
nphi.with: Africa CDC
nphi.summary: Reciprocal visits in Nov and Dec 2024 on disease prevention and control, surveillance and the mpox response.

nphi.title: China CDC – Robert Koch Institute memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Robert Koch Institute
nphi.summary: Five-year cooperation agreement between the two national institutes on infectious diseases, health emergencies, non-communicable diseases, laboratory safety and workforce training.

nphi.title: China–Egypt collaborative research on schistosomiasis and other vector-borne tropical diseases

nphi.title: China CDC – Communicable Diseases Agency Singapore cooperation (MoU 2024, annual roundtables)
nphi.with: Communicable Diseases Agency Singapore (CDA, formerly iCDA)
nphi.summary: Following a 2024 memorandum, China CDC and Singapore's CDA hold annual technical roundtables and personnel exchanges on surveillance, preparedness, FETP, One Health, AMR and wastewater surveillance.

nphi.title: BRICS Vaccine Research and Development Centre (coordinated by ICMR-NIV)
nphi.with: BRICS member states' health and research agencies
nphi.summary: The BRICS Vaccine Research and Development Centre was launched virtually in 2024 during India's BRICS presidency, with ICMR-NIV Pune as the coordinating agency. It aims to strengthen vaccine R&D and health systems across BRICS member…

nphi.title: China CDC – UNICEF memorandum of understanding

nphi.summary: China CDC and UNICEF signed an MoU in July 2024 to cooperate on training, personnel exchanges and joint fundraising to coordinate support for African countries, with China CDC experts joining UNICEF projects and technical activities.

nphi.title: China CDC – Myanmar National CDC memorandum of cooperation
nphi.with: Myanmar National Centre for Disease Control and Medical Training Centre (Myanmar National CDC)
nphi.summary: In June 2024 China CDC signed a memorandum of cooperation with Myanmar's newly built National CDC. It covers infectious and chronic disease control, laboratory capacity, health promotion and health emergency response.

nphi.title: Fiocruz – CEEID Sino-Brazilian infectious disease centre

nphi.title: China CDC – KDCA memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA)

nphi.title: China CDC – KDCA memorandum of understanding (renewed 2023)
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in Seoul in December 2023, continuing an earlier edition. It covers 11 areas, including communicable and non-communicable disease surveillance, prevention and control, and emergency preparedness, plus new chronic-disease…

nphi.title: China–Zimbabwe schistosomiasis elimination project and National Center for International Research on Tropical Diseases

nphi.summary: China CDC's Global Public Health Center and WHO hold a yearly training for Western Pacific public health staff on EIOS open-source epidemic intelligence, multi-source surveillance data and rapid risk assessment. The 2025 round, the third,…

nphi.title: China CDC – NIH Pakistan memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: National Institute of Health (NIH) Pakistan
nphi.summary: MoU signed in February 2021 covering communicable disease prevention and control, laboratory quality and biosafety, and training in molecular diagnostics.

nphi.title: China CDC – NCCD Mongolia memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: National Center for Communicable Diseases (NCCD) Mongolia
nphi.summary: MoU signed in December 2021 on communicable disease surveillance and control, epidemiology research and training, immunization and vaccine research, and lab quality and biosafety, with joint COVID-19 technical exchanges.

nphi.title: China CDC – Mongolia NCCD memorandum of understanding (2021, renewed 2026)
nphi.with: National Center for Communicable Diseases (NCCD) of Mongolia
nphi.summary: MoU first signed in December 2021 and renewed in September 2026 for a new five-year cycle, covering emerging infectious diseases, TB and HIV, workforce development, surveillance IT and emergency response, with plans for FETP and…

nphi.title: China CDC – Rospotrebnadzor cooperation memorandum
nphi.with: Federal Service for Surveillance on Consumer Rights Protection and Human Wellbeing (Rospotrebnadzor)
nphi.summary: Cooperation memorandum signed in 2020 covering infectious disease research, prevention and COVID-19 experience sharing. The heads of both agencies met in Beijing in 2024 to plan further exchanges.

nphi.title: China CDC – US CDC cooperation and virtual technical exchange teleconference series
nphi.with: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (US CDC) and its China Program
nphi.summary: Long-standing partnership that includes a technical teleconference series running since 2020 (34th session in 2025), annual heads-of-agency meetings, and joint training such as the TB infection-control educator course.

nphi.title: China–Russia Infectious Disease Symposium series
nphi.with: Smorodintsev Research Institute of Influenza; National Research Center for Fundamental and Translational Medicine; other Russian institutes
nphi.summary: Annual bilateral symposium on infectious disease prevention and control, co-organised by China CDC and Russia's Smorodintsev Influenza Institute since 2018; the eighth edition was held in Saint Petersburg in 2025.

nphi.title: China–Kazakhstan exchange on plague and zoonotic disease control

nphi.title: South-South Cooperation Technical Exchange Workshop on HIV/AIDS Prevention and Control
nphi.actor: China CDC National Center for AIDS/STD Control and Prevention
nphi.with: UNAIDS China Office; African Union; HIV programme managers from 16 countries
nphi.summary: Annual workshop run by NCAIDS since 2017, with UNAIDS support, in which HIV programme managers from developing countries study China's HIV prevention and control practice in Beijing and Kunming.

nphi.title: IANPHI Asia Regional Network

nphi.title: China–Myanmar workshop on malaria elimination and infectious disease control

nphi.summary: Annual bilateral workshop held since 2014, alternating between China and Myanmar, on malaria elimination in the border area and wider infectious disease control. The 8th edition was in Nay Pyi Taw in 2024.

nphi.title: ASEAN+3 Field Epidemiology Training Network (ASEAN+3 FETN)

nphi.title: CDC China – collaboration with China CDC
nphi.with: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC); Chinese Field Epidemiology Training Program (CFETP); provincial and local CDCs

nphi.title: Mekong Basin Disease Surveillance (MBDS) network
nphi.with: Ministries of health / disease control departments of the six Mekong Basin countries; MBDS Foundation
nphi.summary: Regional network founded in 2001 under a health-ministerial MoU linking six Mekong countries for cross-border surveillance, outbreak investigation and response, information sharing and capacity building; secretariat c/o Thailand's DDC.

nphi.title: China–Japan–Korea Forum for Communicable Disease Control and Prevention

nphi.title: China–Laos–Cambodia Accelerated Schistosomiasis Elimination Cooperation Project

nphi.summary: South-South project funded by the Asian Cooperation Fund in which NIPD experts support Laos and Cambodia in eliminating Mekong schistosomiasis through field missions, surveillance and lab support.

nphi.title: Pilot of integrated community HIV and viral hepatitis prevention in Sierra Leone
nphi.actor: China CDC National Center for AIDS/STD Control and Prevention
nphi.with: Sierra Leone Ministry of Health; National AIDS Control Programme; National AIDS Secretariat

nphi.title: Japan–China–Korea Forum for Communicable Disease Control and Prevention
nphi.with: NIID / NCGM (Japan Institute for Health Security), Japan; KDCA, South Korea

nphi.title: Institution-Based Network on China–Africa Cooperation for Schistosomiasis Elimination
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: University of Yaoundé; Theodor Bilharz Research Institute (Egypt); African schistosomiasis programmes
nphi.summary: Network of Chinese and African institutions working on schistosomiasis elimination, hosted by NIPD. Its 7th annual meeting was held in Haikou in 2022.

nphi.title: China CDC – Fondation Mérieux partnership
nphi.with: Fondation Mérieux

nphi.title: NIPD – Swiss TPH strategic partnership on tropical diseases
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases

nphi.title: BRICS TB Research Network meetings

nphi.summary: Recurring international symposium co-organised by NIPD and Swiss TPH on surveillance-response systems for eliminating tropical diseases. The 2026 Shanghai edition also hosted annual meetings of China–Africa and Asian schistosomiasis,…

nphi.title: Pasteur Network (Institut Pasteur International Network)
nphi.with: Pasteur Network members incl. Institut Pasteur de Dakar, de Bangui, de Côte d'Ivoire, de Guinée, du Maroc, de Madagascar, de Tunis, d'Algérie, du Cambodge, du Laos, Korea, Montevideo, São Paulo; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; CERMES Niger; Fiocruz; NIHE, Pasteur Institutes Nha Trang and Ho Chi Minh City; Pasteur Institute of Iran; HKU-Pasteur Research Pole; Sciensano; Stephan Angeloff Institute; Hellenic Pasteur Institute; Institut Pasteur in Saint Petersburg

nphi.with: China–Sierra Leone Friendship Biosafety Laboratory; Sierra Leone National Tuberculosis Laboratory; Ministry of Health and Sanitation
nphi.summary: The fourth phase of China's technical cooperation project at the Friendship Biosafety Laboratory in Freetown, which serves as Sierra Leone's reference lab for viral haemorrhagic fevers and a training centre for pathogen detection and…

nphi.title: China CDC – Saudi Public Health Authority leadership meeting on technical cooperation
nphi.with: Saudi Public Health Authority (Weqaya)
nphi.summary: The acting CEO of the Saudi Public Health Authority met China CDC's director in Beijing to select priority areas (immunization, emergency response, surveillance) under the China–Saudi health MoU and set up regular technical exchanges.

nphi.title: China CDC – INS Colombia technical exchange

nphi.summary: First bilateral video meeting between the two institutes, framed as the start of cooperation on surveillance, emergency preparedness and laboratory capacity. No formal agreement is mentioned.

nphi.title: Gulf CDC delegation technical exchange at China CDC

nphi.title: Training course on emerging and re-emerging infectious disease control for Africa
nphi.with: Health professionals from African ministries and public health agencies
nphi.summary: Two-week foreign-aid course (September 2025) sponsored by China's Ministry of Commerce and run by China CDC for 22 African health professionals on surveillance, laboratory testing, outbreak control and emergency response.

nphi.title: Burkina Faso INSP delegation exchange with China CDC NIPD
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases

nphi.title: Seminar on Plague Prevention and Control in SCO Countries

nphi.summary: A 2025 Beijing seminar, followed by a Xinjiang–Central Asia technical exchange, to advance technical collaboration and joint plague control mechanisms among SCO countries.

nphi.title: China Public Health Team deployment to Myanmar after the 2025 earthquake
nphi.with: Myanmar health authorities (unnamed); Yunnan CDC
nphi.summary: China CDC experts and Yunnan CDC formed a public health team that carried out risk assessment, water testing, vector surveillance, disinfection and vaccination guidance, and trained local staff after the 7.9-magnitude earthquake.

nphi.title: China–Mongolia occupational health exchange

nphi.with: Ministry of Health of Mongolia
nphi.summary: A Mongolian Ministry of Health delegation visited NIOHP in January 2025. Both sides agreed to strengthen occupational disease regulation and raise occupational health service standards.

nphi.title: China CDC – Honduras exchange on vector-borne disease control
nphi.with: Ministry of Health of Honduras (Vector-Borne Disease Programme); GX Foundation
nphi.summary: A Honduran Ministry of Health delegation visited China CDC in January 2025 to explore cooperation on vector-borne disease control and emergency response capacity.

nphi.with: Lao Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: A delegation from China's National Disease Control and Prevention Administration met Lao Ministry of Health leaders in Vientiane to strengthen bilateral cooperation on communicable disease prevention and control. The meeting prepared a…

nphi.title: China CDC – ECDC technical exchange on public health workforce training
nphi.with: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC)
nphi.summary: An online exchange in January 2024 on EPIET/EUPHEM and China's CFETP and public health training, with intent to keep sharing information on workforce development.

nphi.summary: Under Brazil's G20 presidency, Fiocruz, IANPHI and Africa CDC convened NPHI leaders on emergency preparedness, climate and health, equity and resilient health systems.

nphi.title: Afghanistan Minister of Public Health visit to China CDC

nphi.summary: Afghanistan's Minister of Public Health visited China CDC in December 2024 for talks on health emergency management and infectious disease surveillance and testing, including the National Influenza Center and mobile laboratory.

nphi.title: Singapore iCDA – Hong Kong CHP MoU on communicable disease prevention and control
nphi.with: Centre for Health Protection, Department of Health, Hong Kong SAR
nphi.summary: MoU signed in August 2024 between Singapore's interim Communicable Diseases Agency and Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection on surveillance, outbreak investigation, AMR, research, training and emergency exercises.

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Fellowships phase 2 – Bangladesh and Sri Lanka (host institution CUHK)
nphi.actor: Chinese University of Hong Kong (Jockey Club School of Public Health and Primary Care)

nphi.summary: CUHK hosts phase 2 Fleming Fellowships (2024–2025) that mentor fellows from public health, disease control and laboratory institutions in Bangladesh and Sri Lanka on One Health AMR surveillance.

nphi.with: WHO Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN); Guangdong Provincial CDC; national public health agencies of the participating countries
nphi.summary: China CDC and GOARN ran a three-day workshop in Guangzhou on deploying international public health emergency teams. It covered GOARN Tier 1.5 training and training of trainers for participants from eight ASEAN countries, Sri Lanka and…

nphi.title: China CDC – NIID bilateral leaders meeting and technical exchange
nphi.with: National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID), Japan

nphi.title: China CDC – Japan NIID bilateral cooperation
nphi.with: National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID), Japan
nphi.summary: At a 2023 leaders' meeting, the two institutes agreed to build on their information sharing, technical exchange and joint research by setting up a regular technical exchange mechanism and personnel training on influenza, immunization…

nphi.title: China CDC technical support for Myanmar CDC development
nphi.with: Myanmar National Center for Disease Control (Myanmar CDC); Myanmar Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: During a 2023 visit by Myanmar's deputy health minister, China CDC offered to share experience and give technical support for building and running Myanmar's national CDC. Both sides proposed cooperation on malaria, HIV, TB and dengue,…

nphi.title: China CDC – Cambodia CNM technical exchange on dengue emergency response
nphi.with: National Center for Parasitology, Entomology and Malaria Control (CNM), Cambodia
nphi.summary: A Cambodian CNM delegation visited China CDC in December 2023 to learn from China's dengue surveillance and emergency management and to improve Cambodia's dengue response plan.

nphi.title: Support for Sierra Leone's first National Viral Hepatitis Strategic Plan
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Sanitation of Sierra Leone; WHO
nphi.summary: China CDC worked with Sierra Leone's Ministry of Health and Sanitation and WHO to draft the country's first national viral hepatitis strategic plan, launched in December 2023.

nphi.title: Saudi Public Health Authority – BGI Genomics MoU
nphi.with: BGI Genomics
nphi.summary: MoU signed in October 2023 extending earlier cooperation on infectious disease screening and detection to reproductive health, early cancer screening, joint research and talent development.

nphi.title: China CDC – EPHI memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI)
nphi.summary: MoU signed by video link in August 2022 covering infectious disease prevention and control, maternal and child nutrition, and laboratory testing capacity, with interest in China's malaria-elimination experience.

nphi.title: Quadrilateral plague prevention and control cooperation (China–Russia–Mongolia–Kazakhstan)
nphi.with: Russian Research Anti-Plague Institute 'Microbe'; National Center for Zoonotic Disease (Mongolia); National Scientific Center for Especially Dangerous Infections (Kazakhstan)
nphi.summary: China CDC hosted a 2021 webinar with plague institutes from Russia, Mongolia and Kazakhstan to share plague control technologies and work toward a joint cross-border plague control mechanism.

nphi.title: China CDC – ASEAN (Plus Three) public health emergency tabletop exercises
nphi.with: National health authorities of ASEAN member states; ASEAN Secretariat; Malaysia NIH Biobank; Singapore public health laboratory
nphi.summary: A series of online workshops and tabletop exercises for ASEAN health authorities: health emergency response under ASEAN+3 (2021), IT-supported outbreak investigation (2022), and preservation and use of pathogen resources (2025).

nphi.title: China CDC–Rospotrebnadzor memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Rospotrebnadzor (Federal Service for Surveillance on Consumer Rights Protection and Human Wellbeing)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in 2020 on communicable disease prevention and control, emergency preparedness and response, and joint laboratory research methods.

nphi.title: Butantan–Sinovac CoronaVac clinical development and production partnership
nphi.with: Sinovac Biotech
nphi.summary: Agreement of June 2020 under which Butantan ran Phase III trials of Sinovac's inactivated COVID-19 vaccine in Brazil, as the first step toward technology licensing and local production.

nphi.title: China CDC – ZNPHI memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Zambia National Public Health Institute (ZNPHI)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in July 2019 between China CDC and Zambia's national public health institute focusing on public health capacity building, health informatics and laboratory strengthening.

nphi.title: Albania ISHP–China CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.actor: Institute of Public Health of Albania (ISHP)
nphi.with: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in 2019 for cooperation on disease monitoring, biosafety and occupational health.

nphi.title: China CDC–INRSP Madagascar memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Institut National de Recherche en Santé Publique (INRSP), Madagascar
nphi.summary: MoU signed in November 2019 on infectious disease control, emergency response and training in diagnostic techniques.

nphi.title: China CDC–Gamaleya–Smorodintsev tripartite memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Gamaleya National Research Center of Epidemiology and Microbiology; Smorodintsev Research Institute of Influenza
nphi.summary: Tripartite MoU signed in 2018 on infectious disease diagnostics and training.

nphi.title: Fiocruz – China CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
nphi.summary: International cooperation MoU between Fiocruz and China CDC on public health and infectious disease cooperation.

nphi.title: Hungary NPHI–China CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.actor: National Public Health Institute of Hungary (now NNGYK)
nphi.with: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in 2017 covering public health emergency response, laboratory safety, immunisation and drinking-water safety.

nphi.title: China CDC–Fiocruz memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Oswaldo Cruz Foundation (Fiocruz)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in November 2017 on joint research and development of laboratory diagnostic methods.

nphi.title: China–UK Global Health project on public health capacity in Sierra Leone
nphi.with: Ministry of Health and Sanitation Sierra Leone; Sierra Leone-China Friendship Biological Safety Laboratory; Sierra Leone-China Friendship Hospital; Public Health England (UK partner)
nphi.summary: Under the China-UK Global Health Support Programme, China CDC worked with Sierra Leone's Ministry of Health and with Public Health England. Together they set up bacteriology and parasitology labs, wrote SOPs (cholera, typhoid, malaria…

nphi.title: Switzerland–China health cooperation agreement
nphi.with: Chinese health and regulatory authorities
nphi.summary: FOPH cooperation agreement with China covering food, medicines, medical devices and cosmetics.

nphi.title: China CDC – PHE/UKHSA cooperation (MoUs 2015 and 2018)
nphi.with: Public Health England / UK Health Security Agency
nphi.summary: China CDC signed MoUs with Public Health England in 2015 and 2018, covering exchanges on salt reduction, emergency response, lab safety, environmental health and vaccine evaluation. A 2022 heads-of-agency meeting with UKHSA continued the…

nphi.title: PHE–China CDC memoranda of understanding
nphi.with: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
nphi.summary: PHE and China CDC signed MoUs in 2015 and 2018 underpinning exchanges on salt reduction, emergency response, lab safety, environmental health and vaccine evaluation; UKHSA and China CDC discussed continuing these in 2022.

nphi.title: Public Health Agency of Sweden–China CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
nphi.summary: The two agencies signed an MoU in 2015 and cooperate on infectious disease control.

nphi.title: China–ASEAN Epidemiology Professional Training Programme (CFETP)
nphi.actor: China CDC (China Field Epidemiology Training Program)
nphi.with: NHFPC International Exchange and Cooperation Center; ministries of health of ASEAN member states
nphi.summary: China CDC's field epidemiology training programme ran short field-epidemiology courses in Beijing for ASEAN health staff. The courses were part of the China–ASEAN Public Health Talent Cultivation 100-Person Plan (2014–2017), commissioned…

nphi.title: Sierra Leone–China Friendship BSL-3 laboratory (Ebola response)
nphi.with: Sierra Leone-China Friendship Biological Safety Laboratory (Freetown); Ministry of Health and Sanitation
nphi.summary: During the West African Ebola epidemic, China built a fixed BSL-3 laboratory in Freetown, and China CDC staffed it with rotating teams. The lab began Ebola testing in March 2015 under good-laboratory-practice and biosafety procedures.

nphi.title: Institut Pasteur–China CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in 2014 to improve laboratory diagnosis and research capacities.

nphi.title: Workshop for field epidemiology officials from Asian countries (CFETP, MOFCOM-funded)
nphi.actor: China CDC (China Field Epidemiology Training Program)
nphi.with: NHFPC International Exchange and Cooperation Center; Ministry of Commerce (aid training)
nphi.summary: CFETP hosted a three-week aid-funded workshop in Beijing for 20 field epidemiology officials from seven Asian countries. It was the second such workshop for Asian countries, and a 2015 round followed.

nphi.title: NIVDC – Columbia University Joint Research Laboratory for Pathogen Discovery
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute for Viral Disease Control and Prevention (NIVDC)
nphi.with: Center for Infection and Immunity, Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health
nphi.summary: NIVDC and Columbia University's Center for Infection and Immunity agreed in May 2013 to set up a joint pathogen discovery lab in Beijing, to monitor disease, detect new microbes and develop diagnostics, drugs and vaccines.

nphi.title: IANPHI evaluation team review of China CDC
nphi.with: China CDC (evaluated); experts from Morocco, Norway, China and the US (led by Jeffrey Koplan)
nphi.summary: In 2011, an IANPHI evaluation team led by Jeffrey Koplan, with experts from Morocco, Norway, China and the US, reviewed China CDC.

nphi.title: Canada–China Plan of Action on Cooperation in the field of health (Health Canada/PHAC)
nphi.with: Ministry of Health of the People's Republic of China; Health Canada
nphi.summary: Health Canada, PHAC and China's Ministry of Health agreed a 2011–2014 plan of action for health cooperation, following an earlier 2005–2008 plan that covered public health emergencies such as infectious disease outbreaks.

nphi.title: China CDC – Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center (Seattle)
nphi.summary: A 2010 MoU giving a framework for joint research and training on the prevention, early detection and treatment of cancer and infectious diseases. It formalized collaboration on HIV/AIDS since 2003 and on the 2009 EV71 outbreak analysis.

nphi.title: International Emerging Infections Program (IEIP) sites
nphi.with: icddr,b (Bangladesh); Egyptian MoHP and NAMRU-3; GDD Regional Centre partners in China, Guatemala, Kenya and Thailand
nphi.summary: CDC's International Emerging Infections Program ran population-based surveillance and research on emerging infections at six sites, mostly within the GDD Regional Centers, with a Bangladesh site formalised with icddr,b in 2009.

nphi.title: ECDC–China CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
nphi.summary: Since a 2007 MoU, ECDC and China CDC have cooperated on epidemic intelligence and response, syndromic surveillance for mass gatherings, preparedness and AMR.

nphi.title: China–Myanmar cross-border malaria control under the Global Fund (rounds 6 and 10)
nphi.with: Myanmar Ministry of Health and Sports; Health Poverty Action; Myanmar special region health authorities
nphi.summary: The Yunnan Institute of Parasitic Diseases and Health Poverty Action ran Global Fund malaria projects in Chinese border counties and Myanmar special regions. The work followed a 2005 China–Myanmar health ministry agreement on cross-border…

nphi.title: China CDC–NIID memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID), Japan (now JIHS)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in August 2006 for joint research on influenza and vaccine-preventable diseases, with annual directors' meetings.

nphi.title: APEIR – Asia Partnership on Emerging Infectious Diseases Research
nphi.actor: Universitas Indonesia, Faculty of Public Health (APEIR coordinating office)
nphi.with: Researchers, practitioners and senior officials in member countries; Connecting Organizations for Regional Disease Surveillance (CORDS)
nphi.summary: Regional research partnership founded in 2006 linking researchers and government officials in six Asian countries on emerging infectious diseases and their burden on poor and marginalised groups; a member network of CORDS.

nphi.title: China CDC–KDCA memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA, formerly KCDC)
nphi.summary: MoU signed in 2004 and renewed in 2019 on emergency preparedness, emerging infectious disease monitoring, joint research, staff exchange and training.

nphi.title: Global Disease Detection (GDD) Regional Centers network
nphi.with: Host ministries of health / national public health institutes (not named on source page)
nphi.summary: CDC set up ten GDD Regional Centers between 2004 and 2013, working with host governments on outbreak detection and response, laboratory capacity, field epidemiology training and pandemic preparedness.

nphi.title: China CDC–US CDC memorandum of understanding
nphi.with: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
nphi.summary: Under a 2002 MoU the two CDCs collaborate on emerging infections, pandemic preparedness, NCDs, immunisation, lab quality, environmental health, tobacco control, FETP and global health.

nphi.title: China–UK–Tanzania Pilot Project on Malaria Control
nphi.actor: China CDC National Institute of Parasitic Diseases
nphi.with: Ifakara Health Institute; National Malaria Control Programme (Tanzania); UK DFID
nphi.summary: A roughly three-year pilot under the DFID-backed China–UK Global Health Support Programme in which NIPD and Ifakara Health Institute applied a paired 'learning by doing' malaria control approach in Tanzania. It was followed by a…

nphi.title: Santé publique France–China CDC cooperation
nphi.with: Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC)
nphi.summary: China CDC lists Santé publique France as an international partner for collaboration on infectious disease surveillance, NCDs, occupational health and environmental health.

nphi.title: China–Japan–Korea Forum on Communicable Disease Control and Prevention
nphi.with: National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID), Japan; Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA)
nphi.summary: Tripartite mechanism of the three national CDCs for scientific exchange and information sharing on communicable diseases, hosted in rotation; the 15th forum was held online in 2021.

nphi.title: SISEA – regional initiative to strengthen epidemic response capacity in Southeast Asia
nphi.actor: National Center for Laboratory and Epidemiology (NCLE), Lao PDR
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur du Cambodge; Institut Pasteur of Shanghai; NIHE Vietnam; Institut Pasteur (Paris)
nphi.summary: A regional initiative building coordinated surveillance of respiratory infections and acute encephalitis; NCLE's director sat on its four-member steering committee and NCLE hosted steering committee meetings in Vientiane in 2008.
